skills.quote: Coordinates all aspects of onsite conferencing and meeting

experience_without_number: Facilities Management and/or Office Services experience.
Previous hotel/hospitality front-of-house experience is also welcomed.
Basic knowledge of or experience in cyber security.

qualifications.quote: the Workplace Services Coordinator must have a passion for hospitality and customer service, ensuring every in-office experience is functional, productive, and memorable for our fellow CrowdStrikers.

The individual must have the ability to work independently on various projects from conception to completion, adhere to pivotal business and operational timelines, and work through a variety of activities and confidential matters with discretion.
Facilities Management and/or Office Services experience. Previous hotel/hospitality front-of-house experience is also welcomed.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills including ability to communicate with all levels of staff, clients, and external professionals.
Ability to interact with people at all levels including senior management.
Basic understanding of local building and fire codes, Fire/Life/Safety plans, and Environmental Health & Safety standards.
Basic understanding of commercial MEP systems and functionalities.
Basic understanding of Audio/Visual conferencing systems.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize multiple, high-priority tasks.
Unimpeachable judgment and discretion in handling confidential information.
Flexibility to perform job tasks outside of job description when necessary.
Keen attention to detail with the ability to juggle multiple priorities.
High level of integrity and ethics with the ability to maintain confidentiality.
Strong working knowledge of Google and Microsoft Office Suite.
Basic knowledge of or experience in cyber security.
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

notes: 'What You'll Need' treated as a required heading. The two 'must have' sentences in About the Role are labeled required qualifications. The hospitality front-of-house line is 'also welcomed' (arguably preferred) but shares a bullet with the required facilities line, so the bullet is 'required'. Company boilerplate mentions distributed systems; excluded as not about this role. Several skills are inferred from duties (event coordination, inventory management, procurement, budgeting, forecasting) and use weak quotes; reviewer may drop. 'Google' quote is ambiguous (likely Google Workspace). E-Verify participation is not a sponsorship statement. Review: no changes; duty-derived skills kept because they are named practices of the job family.
